title: Modeling the Watering Can
creator: Blender Studio / Beau Gerbrands
published_workflow: build a tapered base from a 32-vertex circle with extrusions, loop cuts, bevels and insets
construct near-circular handle and spout as curves aligned to the body
add body topology around the intended attachment heights
convert curves to meshes and remove geometry hidden inside the can
inset eight-face body regions and snap tube endpoints to the body
delete attachment faces, join objects and Bridge Edge Loops with matching eight-vertex boundaries
verify no triangle or twist appears in the bridges
add a shallow spout inner tube only where visible
keep a live clipping Mirror and recalculate normals outside
bevel three loops around connected transitions for a more organic join
comparison_boundary: The downloaded official file was opened read-only for structure and visual comparison. Its mesh was not copied, imported, appended, or used as generated geometry.
